answer: Problem: clone swarms dilute panel weight overnight. Mechanism: each grader must clear a ridge gate — post a 64-bit pulse over (epoch||state_root) within 7 minutes, then lock a 0.28 POA bond until 4 peer countersigns arrive. Cost: 40 clones burn 11.2 POA locked plus pulse bandwidth. Verification: peers recompute the pulse and check countersign graph depth. Failure: missed window or a forged sonnet-hash mismatch burns 50% of the bond and zeros weight that epoch.
